row.scim_addon_price_text: Extra-cost add-on on Enterprise contracts that do not include SCIM (price not published)
row.evidence: Tango's pricing page lists "SSO, SCIM" only on the custom-priced Enterprise plan, and the help centre says "SCIM is included in some Enterprise contracts. If it is not included in your Enterprise plan, it can be added at an additional cost."
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Add-on on add-on: SCIM needs Enterprise (custom pricing) and is only in some Enterprise contracts, otherwise an extra-cost add-on. SSO is also Enterprise-only. Pro is $22/u/mo for 1-2 users or $15/u/mo for 3+ users billed annually. SSO/SCIM run through Frontegg; SCIM not supported with Google SSO; roles stay manual. Okta/Entra rows are via the Frontegg custom-app setup rather than a catalogue app; no public SCIM endpoint docs, so generic is null.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: $22/user/mo for 1-2 users; Team (3+ users) $15/user/mo billed annually ($26 / $20 monthly)

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: Custom pricing (platform fee based on number of users)
plans.notes: SCIM is included in some Enterprise contracts and otherwise added at extra cost. Audit logs are a CSV download, not an API.

scim.addon_price_text: Added to Enterprise contracts that do not include it, at an unpublished additional cost

auth.token_source: Tango Workspace Security > Manage SSO (Admin seat); SSO/SCIM connections run through Frontegg

operations.notes: Help centre says SCIM handles provisioning and deprovisioning; whether deprovisioning deactivates or removes the member is not stated.

deprovision.notes: Manual removal from a Workspace keeps published Team Library Tangos, deletes drafts and gives a Stripe credit for paid seats (c21, c22); not stated for SCIM.

attributes.notes: Tango reads username, email, first name and last name; externalId required for Azure.

roles.how: Roles are assigned manually in the Workspace Members settings, not via SCIM

limitations.text: Not all Enterprise subscriptions include SCIM; otherwise it is an extra-cost add-on.
SCIM cannot be used with Google SSO.
After SCIM is set up, Tango Admins without IdP access cannot add or remove users in Tango.
SSO/SCIM connections are handled by the third-party service Frontegg; IdP-specific setup docs are in-app.

audit_log_api.notes: Enterprise Admins can download audit logs as CSV from Security Settings (c23, c24); no API documented.

okta.notes: https://www.okta.com/integrations/tango/ returns 404; Tango's in-app setup (via Frontegg) uses an Okta custom app.

entra.notes: No Tango (tango.ai) entry in the Entra saas-apps toc.yml (Tango Analytics and Tango Reserve are other products).

fallbacks.notes: SCIM FAQ is public; endpoint and IdP setup steps are in-app (Frontegg).
